name: Acid Splash
description: You hurl a bubble of acid at one creature within range, or at two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage.

name: Blade Ward
description: In 2024 rules: As a Reaction when a creature attacks you, you impose Disadvantage on that attack roll and gain a +1 bonus to your AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Chill Touch
description: Make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

name: Dancing Lights
description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air.

name: Druidcraft
description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create a tiny sensory effect: predict the weather for 24 hours, make a flower blossom instantly, or light/snuff a small flame.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Force damage.

name: Fire Bolt
description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. Flammable objects ignite if not worn or carried.

name: Guidance
description: In 2024 rules: Cast as a Reaction when you or a creature within 10 feet makes an ability check. The creature adds 1d4 to the roll.

name: Light
description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

name: Mage Hand
description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. You can use your action to control the hand to manipulate objects up to 10 pounds.

name: Mending
description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken link of a chain, two halves of a broken key, or a leaking wineskin.

name: Message

components.materialText: a short piece of copper wire

description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

name: Minor Illusion
description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion is dismissable or revealed by Investigation check.

name: Poison Spray
description: In 2024 rules: Make a ranged spell attack against a target within 30 feet. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 Poison damage.

name: Prestidigitation
description: Perform minor magical tricks: spark sparks/music, clean or soil an object, warm or chill food, make a color/mark appear, or create a small trinket.

name: Ray of Frost
description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover.

name: Shillelagh
description: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you hold is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls, and its damage die becomes a d8.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Lightning springs from your hand. Make a melee spell attack (with Advantage if target is in metal armor). On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage and cannot make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

name: Spare the Dying
description: In 2024 rules: You touch or point to a living creature within 15 feet that has 0 Hit Points. The creature becomes Stable.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: You manifest minor wonders: booming voice (3x louder), flickering flames, tremors, ominous whispers, or opening/slamming unlocked doors.

name: Thorn Whip

components.materialText: a stem of a thorny plant

description: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet. On hit, deal 1d6 Piercing damage and pull the creature up to 10 feet closer to you if Large or smaller.

name: True Strike

components.materialText: a weapon worth at least 1 CP

description: In 2024 rules: You make one weapon attack using your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage roll. On hit, the weapon deals its normal damage plus Radiant damage.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments. Target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d6 Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

name: Armor of Agathys
description: A protective magical frost covers you. You gain 5 temporary Hit Points. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, it takes 5 Cold damage.

name: Bless
description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can add 1d4 to the roll.

name: Burning Hands
description: A thin sheet of flames shoots from your fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Charm Person
description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw (with Advantage if you or your companions are fighting it). If failed, it is Charmed by you.

name: Cure Wounds
description: In 2024 rules: A creature you touch regains Hit Points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier (upgraded from 1d8 in 2014!).

name: Detect Magic
description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object that bears magic.

name: Divine Smite
description: In 2024 rules: Cast as a Bonus Action immediately after you hit a target with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike. The target takes 2d8 extra Radiant damage (increases by 1d8 against Fiends/Undead).

name: Faerie Fire
description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light. Any creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be outlined in light, giving attackers Advantage.

name: Feather Fall

components.materialText: a small feather or piece of down

description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends, taking no falling damage upon landing.

name: Find Familiar

components.materialText: 10 GP worth of charcoal, incense, and herbs

description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish, rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has Advantage.

name: Healing Word
description: In 2024 rules: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier (upgraded from 1d4 in 2014!).

name: Hellish Rebuke
description: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellfire. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll.

name: Mage Armor
description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

name: Magic Missile
description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range, dealing 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target. The darts strike simultaneously.

name: Sanctuary
description: You ward a creature within range against attack. Any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.

name: Shield
description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

name: Shield of Faith

components.materialText: a small parchment with holy text

description: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

name: Sleep
description: In 2024 rules: Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Incapacitated condition and fall Unconscious.

name: Thunderwave
description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you.
